faq.q: What is the price of plots for sale in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: Starting at ₹4,500–₹6,500 per sq.ft.; a 1,200 sq.ft. plot costs approximately ₹60–70 lakhs, with EMI options available.

faq.q: What is the stamp duty for buying land in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: Tamil Nadu applies 7% stamp duty on properties above ₹10 lakhs, plus 1% registry and 4% on guideline value if higher — totalling 8–12% of plot cost.

faq.q: Can I get a home loan for buying a plot in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: Yes — major banks offer up to 80% financing for CMDA/DTCP-approved plots at rates from 8.5%.

faq.q: Is investing in plots in Thirumullaivoyal a good long-term decision?
faq.a: Yes — 15–20% annual appreciation is common here, driven by metro expansion and IT proximity, making it a low-risk, high-return option.

faq.q: Can NRIs buy plots in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: Yes — using repatriable funds per FEMA guidelines; no RBI approval required for direct purchases.

faq.q: Are plots in Thirumullaivoyal CMDA or DTCP approved?
faq.a: OmShakthy's projects here carry both CMDA and DTCP certification.

faq.q: What documents should I check before buying a plot in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: CMDA/DTCP approval, a 30-year encumbrance certificate, patta, survey sketch, sale deed, and tax receipts.

faq.q: How to avoid fraud when buying a plot in Thirumullaivoyal?
faq.a: Deal with reputed builders, verify approvals online, obtain encumbrance searches, avoid cash deals, and get legal review.

faq.q: Is Thirumullaivoyal a good place to buy a plot?
faq.a: Yes — affordable rates, green surroundings, and good connectivity to Chennai via highways and rail.

faq.q: What are the popular localities near Thirumullaivoyal for buying plots?
